Let's parse requirements. Inputs BOOL startBtn resetBtn doneSensor REAL targetVol flowVol. Outputs BOOL valveOpen, INT fillsToday.

We need state per scan order:
1 reset rising priority: clear count and accumulated volume, close valve clear pending, ignore start/flow/confirmation.
2 idle or waiting confirm: start rising begins bottle, zero accumulated, open valve. If previous pending, cancel. During filling new rising doesn't reset.
3 while filling add flowVol, start scan also counts. Accum reaches >= targetVol immediately close and set pending confirm.
4 after closing this scan immediately read doneSensor; if TRUE confirm/count this scan. If FALSE later first TRUE scan confirm unless reset or new start. Each confirm max one bottle; clear pending immediately; sensor staying TRUE not repeated. If new bottle starts scan immediate target reached, confirm new bottle.
5 count INT saturation.

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT ... END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT ... END_VAR
VAR

 prevResetBtn: BOOL := FALSE;
 prevValveOpen: BOOL := FALSE;
 pendingConfirm: BOOL := FALSE;
 accumulatedVol: REAL := 0.0;
 tmp_risingReset: BOOL;
 tmp_risingStart: BOOL;
 tmp_isFilling: BOOL;
 tmp_confirmNow: BOOL;
END_VAR
Then:
tmp_risingReset := resetBtn AND NOT prevResetBtn;
tmp_risingStart := startBtn AND NOT prevStartBtn;
tmp_confirmNow := FALSE;
IF tmp_risingReset THEN
 valveOpen := FALSE;
 fillsToday := 0;
 accumulatedVol := 0.0;
 pendingConfirm := FALSE;
 tmp_isFilling := FALSE;
ELSE
 tmp_isFilling := FALSE;
 IF tmp_risingStart AND NOT valveOpen THEN
    pendingConfirm := FALSE;
    accumulatedVol := 0.0;
    valveOpen := TRUE;
    tmp_isFilling := TRUE;
 ELSIF valveOpen THEN
    tmp_isFilling := TRUE;
 END_IF;
 IF tmp_isFilling THEN
    accumulatedVol := accumulatedVol + flowVol;
    IF accumulatedVol >= targetVol THEN
       valveOpen := FALSE;
       pendingConfirm := TRUE;
       tmp_isFilling := FALSE;
    END_IF;
 END_IF;
 IF pendingConfirm AND doneSensor THEN
    IF fillsToday < 32767 THEN
       fillsToday := fillsToday + 1;
    END_IF;
    pendingConfirm := FALSE;
 END_IF;
END_IF;
prevStartBtn := startBtn;
prevResetBtn := resetBtn;
prevValveOpen := valveOpen;
